extract_post_relax_config: extract post-relaxation filtering parameters like energy cutoff and density cutoff from a workflow config dictionary
filter_single_dataset: filter and deduplicate crystal structures in a single parquet dataset by energy, density, and connectivity
filter_multiple_datasets: orchestrate parallel filtering and deduplication across multiple structure datasets using SLURM job submission
validate_connectivity: validate that covalent bonding networks are preserved during ML relaxation by comparing unrelaxed and relaxed CIF structures
deduplicate_structures: deduplicate crystal structures using pymatgen StructureMatcher with configurable lattice, site, and angle tolerances
